messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Hi, your order Shop····, the Harlo B30 with the free Power Kit, hasn't shipped yet. It ships October 15, both items in the same box.

It's in batch 1, and you can follow that shipment on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Tracking goes to (email hidden) as soon as the label is made. Our mail has been landing in junk for some folks lately, so worth whitelisting us.
I would like to cancel order number Shop····

I'm sorry it's come to that after the wait. Can I ask what changed?

Your B30 is five days out now, October 15, and it comes with the free Power Kit at the price you locked in back in July. That's 30 TH/s for $899, the best per-TH deal we sell, and the units are already built.

If the wait is the issue, tell me and I'll see what I can do for you on it.
Ihave come into a financial burden and unfortunately I have to cancel this order if that is possible. Thank you for your attention with regards to this matter. Chris O.
Handed to the team · cancellation and refund need a person

Understood, Chris, and no problem at all. Nothing has shipped, so there's no fee of any kind. The full $835.49 goes back to the card you paid with.

I've passed the cancellation to Abel and Georges. The team is offline over the weekend and picks it up Monday at 10am ET, and they'll confirm it to (email hidden), so you don't need to wait here.

Once it's issued, the money takes 3 to 5 business days to land. Sorry things got tight, and come back to us when it suits.
Please send all to my E-MAIL Address: (email hidden)

Will do, Chris. Everything goes to (email hidden), the address on the order: the cancellation confirmation from the team Monday, and a copy of this whole conversation once we're done here. You can reply to that email to reach us again.

Worth checking junk or spam too, our mail has been landing there for some customers lately.
